items.claim: claimsAbove counts slot layers that paint under the views
useHostAnchor never follows a host that mounts late or is replaced
one dispose removes a layer two owners registered
items.note: Registering a layer again now also moves it to the top of hit order.

items.claim: headless cull skips a `dependsOn` node by its stored pose box
items.note: A node with `dependsOn` and `derivePath` is drawn by `kit:derived`, which has no `bounds`, so `paintMissesView` never culls it. A `dependsOn` node without `derivePath` has no derived path to draw. A test in `derivedPathCull.test.ts` now pins this.

items.claim: `<SceneCanvas>` scene slot culls a path node by its pose box instead of its pose override's `path`
items.note: The headless view got this fix in 0bb71da607, but the slot in `sceneSlotWiring.ts` never did. Both now share `withOverridePathBounds`, which also carries the path into the slot's `toPose` box.
